scope: Four existing company security policy/IP/MFA models; read-only metadata, unique keys, tenant relations, CIDR normalization, encrypted reasons, bounded lifetime and version guards. No new migration or claim of full R06 acceptance.

constraints.name: IpAccessPolicy_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: IpRule_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: MfaException_tenantId_createdById_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "createdById") REFERENCES "Membership"("tenantId", id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: MfaException_tenantId_memberId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "memberId") REFERENCES "Membership"("tenantId", id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: SecurityPolicy_approval_roles_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((cardinality("approvalRoles") >= 1) AND (cardinality("approvalRoles") <= 3)) AND ('owner'::"Role" = ANY ("approvalRoles")) AND ("approvalRoles" <@ ARRAY['owner'::"Role", 'admin'::"Role", 'security'::"Role"])))

constraints.name: SecurityPolicy_password_rules
constraints.definition: CHECK (((("minPassword" >= 12) AND ("minPassword" <= 128)) AND (("passwordMonths" >= 0) AND ("passwordMonths" <= 12)) AND ("passwordReuse" = ANY (ARRAY[0, 1, 10])) AND ("passwordDeferral" = ANY (ARRAY['never'::text, 'session'::text, 'period'::text])) AND ("passwordRevision" > 0)))

constraints.name: SecurityPolicy_ranges
constraints.definition: CHECK (((("minPassword" >= 12) AND ("minPassword" <= 128)) AND (("sessionMinutes" >= 5) AND ("sessionMinutes" <= 10080)) AND (("retentionDays" >= 1) AND ("retentionDays" <= 36500))))

constraints.name: SecurityPolicy_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

indexes.name: IpAccessPolicy_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "IpAccessPolicy_pkey" ON public."IpAccessPolicy" USING btree ("tenantId")

indexes.name: IpRule_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "IpRule_pkey" ON public."IpRule" USING btree (id)

indexes.name: IpRule_tenantId_cidr_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "IpRule_tenantId_cidr_key" ON public."IpRule" USING btree ("tenantId", cidr)

indexes.name: MfaException_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "MfaException_pkey" ON public."MfaException" USING btree (id)

indexes.name: MfaException_tenantId_expiresAt_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX "MfaException_tenantId_expiresAt_idx" ON public."MfaException" USING btree ("tenantId", "expiresAt")

indexes.name: MfaException_tenantId_memberId_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "MfaException_tenantId_memberId_key" ON public."MfaException" USING btree ("tenantId", "memberId")

indexes.name: SecurityPolicy_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "SecurityPolicy_pkey" ON public."SecurityPolicy" USING btree ("tenantId")

triggers.name: IpAccessPolicy_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER "IpAccessPolicy_guard" BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public."IpAccessPolicy" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_ip_access_policy()

triggers.name: IpRule_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER "IpRule_guard" BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public."IpRule" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_ip_rule()

triggers.name: MfaException_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER "MfaException_guard" BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public."MfaException" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_mfa_exception()

triggers.name: export_policy_access
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER export_policy_access BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public."SecurityPolicy" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION invalidate_export_access()
